title: catalog.thumbnail
description: An item's thumbnail, as base64 image data. of 'source' (default): the blurred thumbnail, shrunk to 24 pixels on its long side and blurred, the only image of a source the engine ever writes to disk (cached, cached true when it was there); with reveal, the clear frame instead, at 320 pixels as JPEG, decoded again for this answer and written nowhere. of 'output': the item's censored output, stored like any thumbnail. catalog.missing when no file of it can be read, catalog.thumbnail_failed when no frame can be made.
